explanations.Adriatic Sea: The arm of the Mediterranean between Italy and the Balkans, in Europe.
explanations.South China Sea: A marginal sea of the Pacific, bounded by southern China and South East Asia.
explanations.Caribbean Sea: A tropical sea south of the Gulf of Mexico, in the Americas.
explanations.Strait of Dover: The narrow strait between England and France, at the eastern end of the Channel.
explanations.Bosporus: The strait at Istanbul, whose eastern shore lies in Asia.
explanations.Strait of Magellan: The sea route through southern Chile, at the tip of South America.
explanations.Iberian Peninsula: The south-western peninsula of Europe, holding Spain and Portugal.
explanations.Korean Peninsula: The peninsula of east Asia on which Korea lies.
explanations.Yucatan Peninsula: The limestone peninsula of south-east Mexico, in the Americas.

sources.excerpt: The Adriatic Sea is a body of water separating the Italian Peninsula from the Balkan Peninsula. The Adriatic is the northernmost arm of the Mediterranean Sea, extending from the Strait of Otranto (where it connects to the Ionian Sea) to the northwest and the Po Valley.

The South China Sea is a marginal sea of the Western Pacific Ocean. It is bounded in the north by South China, in the west by the Indochinese Peninsula, in the east by the islands of Taiwan and northwestern Philippines (mainly Luzon, Mindoro, and Palawan), and in the south by Borneo, eastern Sumatra, and the Bangka Belitung Islands, encompassing an area of around 3,500,000 km2 (1,400,000 sq mi).
The Caribbean Sea is a sea of the North Atlantic Ocean in the tropics of the Western Hemisphere, located south of the Gulf of Mexico and southwest of the Sargasso Sea.

The Strait of Dover or Dover Strait, historically known as the Dover Narrows, is the strait at the narrowest part of the English Channel, marking the boundary between the Channel and the North Sea, and separating Great Britain from continental Europe.

The Bosporus or Bosphorus Strait is a natural strait and an internationally significant waterway located in Turkey which is straddled by the city of Istanbul. The Bosporus connects the Black Sea to the Sea of Marmara and forms one of the continental boundaries between Asia and Europe.

The Strait of Magellan, also called the Straits of Magellan, is a navigable sea route in southern Chile separating mainland South America to the north and the Tierra del Fuego archipelago to the south.
The Iberian Peninsula, also known as Iberia, is a peninsula in southwestern Europe.
Korea is a peninsular region in East Asia consisting of the Korean Peninsula, Jeju Island, and smaller islands.
The Yucatán Peninsula is a large peninsula in southeast Mexico and adjacent portions of Belize and Guatemala.
